method: compare deterministic router output with region evidence from non-null criterion labels

exceptions.note: Right-hip image contains endoprosthesis; right-hip criterion labels are missing. Visual routing identifies the hip correctly.
Both hip images contain endoprostheses; hip criterion labels are missing. Visual routing identifies the hips correctly.

interpretation: The 98/100 figure is only a sanity check because missing criterion labels generally indicate an unperformed region, but the expert Q&A documents anomalies where hip images exist despite missing hip labels. Therefore 98% is not a formal routing accuracy metric.
